plugin.label: GeoServer Manager
plugin.purpose: Open or identify GeoServer Manager. The existing Ribbon G is the brand mark.

workspaces.label: Workspaces
workspaces.purpose: A folder for the namespaces that group stores, layers and styles.

datastores.label: Datastores
datastores.purpose: A database cylinder for vector data sources.

coverage-stores.label: Coverage stores
coverage-stores.purpose: An image frame for raster data sources.

cascaded-stores.label: Cascaded stores
cascaded-stores.purpose: A chain link for connections to remote WMS or WMTS services.

layers.label: Layers
layers.purpose: A neutral stack for all published layer types, including raster and vector.

layer-groups.label: Layer groups
layer-groups.purpose: Brackets contain several layers served together.

styles.label: Styles / set style
styles.purpose: A brush for symbology and choosing a server style.

add-to-qgis.label: Add to QGIS
add-to-qgis.purpose: A layer stack with a plus adds an existing server layer to the project.

preview-map.label: Preview in QGIS
preview-map.purpose: An eye opens a temporary map without adding a layer to the project.

preview-browser.label: Preview in browser
preview-browser.purpose: A browser window with an outward arrow opens the external preview.

browse-resources.label: Browse store contents
browse-resources.purpose: A list shows the coverages or cascaded layers held by a store.

publish-layer.label: Publish a layer
publish-layer.purpose: A layer stack with an upward arrow publishes a store resource on GeoServer.

push-style.label: Push style to GeoServer
push-style.purpose: A brush with a separate upward arrow sends project symbology to the server.

update-from-source.label: Update from the data
update-from-source.purpose: A clockwise arrow around a small database: GeoServer re-reads the data behind a layer and recomputes its bounds.

apply-style.label: Apply style to QGIS
apply-style.purpose: A brush with a separate downward arrow brings server symbology into the project.

save-style.label: Save style to disk
save-style.purpose: A document with a downward arrow writes a style definition to a local file.

clear-cache.label: Truncate cached tiles
clear-cache.purpose: An eraser with a flat contact edge clears tile content but keeps the cache configuration.

remove-cache.label: Stop caching
remove-cache.purpose: A minus removes the cache configuration; the published layer remains.

delete.label: Delete resource
delete.purpose: A familiar bin removes a server resource after confirmation.

settings.label: Settings
settings.purpose: A six-tooth cog opens the plugin settings.

help.label: Help
help.purpose: A question mark opens the documentation.

report-issue.label: Report an issue
report-issue.purpose: A bug opens the issue reporter.

reset-settings.label: Reset settings
reset-settings.purpose: A counterclockwise arrow restores the default settings.

copy-style.label: Copy a style
copy-style.purpose: A sheet in front of another, the front one with two accent lines: the style copied under a new name or into another workspace.

seed-cache.label: Seed or truncate
seed-cache.purpose: A grid of tiles with one slot being added: render (or drop) a layer's tiles for a gridset, format and zoom range.

seed-tasks.label: Seeding tasks
seed-tasks.purpose: Two progress bars: the seed and truncate tasks GeoWebCache is running for a layer.

server.label: Server
server.purpose: Two stacked server units with a status light: the settings of the whole GeoServer.

list-add.label: Add to a list
list-add.purpose: A plus: add the picked or typed name as a new row.

list-remove.label: Remove from a list
list-remove.purpose: A minus: remove the selected row.

move-up.label: Move up
move-up.purpose: An arrow up: move the selected row one place earlier.

move-down.label: Move down
move-down.purpose: An arrow down: move the selected row one place later.

pick-crs.label: Pick a CRS
pick-crs.purpose: A globe: open QGIS's CRS picker to fill an SRS code.
